title: Future continuous and future perfect (continuous)
summary: Future continuous (процесс в будущем, «в обычном ходе событий», вежливые вопросы), future perfect (результат к сроку) и future perfect continuous (длительность к сроку), а также их использование для предположений о настоящем.
ru:
## Future continuous: процесс в будущий момент
**Future continuous** (will be + V-ing) показывает, что в определённый момент будущего действие **будет идти**. Мы как бы «ставим камеру» в этот момент и смотрим, что происходит.
> This time tomorrow I'll be sitting on a plane to Tokyo. — В это время завтра я буду сидеть в самолёте до Токио.
> Don't call at eight; we'll be having dinner. — Не звони в восемь: мы будем ужинать.
> In the summer she'll be working at a camp in the mountains. — Летом она будет работать в лагере в горах.
Сравните: **I'll write to you tomorrow** (решение, будущее действие) и **I'll be writing to you tomorrow** (в этот период я буду этим занят, ход событий).

## Ход событий и вежливые вопросы
Future continuous описывает то, что **произойдёт само собой**, по плану или обычному ходу дел, без нашего особого решения.
> I'll be seeing Dana at the meeting, so I can give her your letter. — Я увижу Дану на совещании (мы и так встретимся), так что передам твоё письмо.
> The bus will be leaving in a few minutes. — Автобус отправится через несколько минут.
Поэтому это время подходит для **вежливых вопросов о планах собеседника**, чтобы не звучать как просьба или давление:
> Will you be using the car tonight? — Вы будете сегодня пользоваться машиной? (я бы хотел её взять)
> Will you be needing the projector after lunch? — Вам понадобится проектор после обеда?
Прямой вопрос **Will you use the car?** звучит как просьба или призыв решить.

## Future perfect: результат к сроку
**Future perfect** (will have + V3) говорит, что действие **завершится к указанному моменту**. Типичные слова: **by, by then, by the time, before, in a year's time**.
> By Friday we'll have finished the first draft. — К пятнице мы закончим первый вариант.
> By the time you get home, I'll have cooked dinner. — К твоему приходу я приготовлю ужин.
> She won't have read the report by then. — К тому времени она не прочитает отчёт.
Важно: **until** и **by** — разные вещи. **I'll be here until six** (буду до шести), **I'll have left by six** (уйду не позже шести).

## Future perfect continuous: длительность к сроку
**Will have been + V-ing** подчёркивает, **как долго** действие будет продолжаться к определённому моменту в будущем.
> In May I'll have been working here for ten years. — В мае я проработаю здесь десять лет.
> By midnight they'll have been negotiating for fourteen hours. — К полуночи переговоры будут идти четырнадцать часов.
С глаголами состояния используем future perfect simple: **In May I'll have known her for ten years.**

## Предположения о настоящем
Will be doing и will have done могут описывать **догадку о том, что происходит сейчас или уже произошло**:
> It's 3 a.m. in Sydney; my cousin will be sleeping. — В Сиднее три часа ночи, мой двоюродный брат, наверное, спит.
> They'll have arrived by now. — Они, наверное, уже приехали.
Часто рядом стоят слова, подчёркивающие предположение: **probably, I expect, I imagine, by now**.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~By Friday I will be finishing the project.~~ → By Friday I **will have finished** the project.
- ~~I will be knowing the results on Monday.~~ → I **will know** the results on Monday.
- ~~By the time you will arrive, I'll have left.~~ → By the time you **arrive**, I'll have left.
- ~~In July she will be working here for five years.~~ → In July she **will have been working** here for five years.
en:
## Future continuous: a process at a future moment
**Future continuous** (will be + -ing) shows that at a certain moment in the future an action **will be in progress**. We 'put a camera' at that moment and see what is going on.
> This time tomorrow I'll be sitting on a plane to Tokyo.
> Don't call at eight; we'll be having dinner.
> In the summer she'll be working at a camp in the mountains.
Compare: **I'll write to you tomorrow** (a decision, a future action) and **I'll be writing to you tomorrow** (I will be busy with this; it is part of the normal course of events).

## The normal course of events and polite questions
Future continuous describes what **will happen anyway**, through plans or the usual routine, without a special decision from us.
> I'll be seeing Dana at the meeting, so I can give her your letter. (we will meet anyway)
> The bus will be leaving in a few minutes.
This is why it suits **polite questions about someone's plans**, so we do not sound as if we are asking or pushing:
> Will you be using the car tonight? (I would like to take it)
> Will you be needing the projector after lunch?
The direct question **Will you use the car?** can sound like a request or a demand for a decision.

## Future perfect: result by a deadline
**Future perfect** (will have + past participle) says that an action **will be completed by the given moment**. Typical words: **by, by then, by the time, before, in a year's time**.
> By Friday we'll have finished the first draft.
> By the time you get home, I'll have cooked dinner.
> She won't have read the report by then.
Note that **until** and **by** are different: **I'll be here until six** (I'll stay till six), **I'll have left by six** (I'll leave no later than six).

## Future perfect continuous: duration by a deadline
**Will have been + -ing** stresses **how long** the action will have been going on by a future moment.
> In May I'll have been working here for ten years.
> By midnight they'll have been negotiating for fourteen hours.
With state verbs we use future perfect simple: **In May I'll have known her for ten years.**

## Guesses about the present
Will be doing and will have done can express **a guess about what is happening now or has already happened**:
> It's 3 a.m. in Sydney; my cousin will be sleeping.
> They'll have arrived by now.
This works with words of probability: **probably, I expect, I imagine, by now**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~By Friday I will be finishing the project.~~ → By Friday I **will have finished** the project.
- ~~I will be knowing the results on Monday.~~ → I **will know** the results on Monday.
- ~~By the time you will arrive, I'll have left.~~ → By the time you **arrive**, I'll have left.
- ~~In July she will be working here for five years.~~ → In July she **will have been working** here for five years.
structure:
## Формы
| | Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|---|
| Future continuous | I will be working. | I won't be working. | Will you be working? |
| Future perfect | I will have finished. | I won't have finished. | Will you have finished? |
| Future perfect continuous | I will have been working. | I won't have been working. | Will you have been working? |

## Формулы
> **will be + V-ing** + момент → в этот момент действие идёт
> At six I'll be driving home.

> **will have + V3** + by / by the time → завершится к сроку
> By six I'll have finished.

> **will have been + V-ing** + for + период → длительность к сроку
> By six I'll have been working for nine hours.

## Сравнительная таблица
| Значение | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Процесс в момент | future continuous | This time next week I'll be skiing. |
| Вежливый вопрос о планах | future continuous | Will you be coming to the meeting? |
| Событие в обычном ходе дел | future continuous | I'll be seeing her tomorrow anyway. |
| Завершение к сроку | future perfect | By June I'll have graduated. |
| Длительность к сроку | future perfect continuous | By June I'll have been studying for four years. |
| Догадка о настоящем | will be doing | He'll be sleeping now. |
| Догадка о завершённом | will have done | They'll have arrived by now. |

## Придаточные
> By the time + **present simple**, ... will have + V3
> By the time you read this, I'll have left.

exercises.title: Какое будущее время?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в future continuous, future perfect или future perfect continuous.
exercises.example: This time next week I (lie) on a beach. → I'll be lying on a beach.

items.text: This time next week I {{will be lying|'ll be lying}} on a beach in Crete.
Don't call at eight; we {{will be having|'ll be having}} dinner.
By the end of June, they {{will have completed|'ll have completed}} the new terminal.
In March, I {{will have been working|'ll have been working|will have worked|'ll have worked}} here for ten years.
{{Will you be using}} the car tonight? If not, could I borrow it?
I'm sure the shops {{will have closed|'ll have closed}} by the time we get there.
At midnight tonight we {{will be crossing|'ll be crossing}} the Atlantic.
By the time you read this, I {{will have left|'ll have left}} the country.
It's 3 a.m. in Tokyo, so my sister {{will be sleeping|'ll be sleeping}}.

exercises.title: Результат, процесс, длительность
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в нужную форму: future continuous, future perfect или future perfect continuous.

items.text: By 2030 the city {{will have built|'ll have built}} three new metro lines.
When you arrive, I {{will be waiting|'ll be waiting}} at the gate.
By this time tomorrow we {{will have landed|'ll have landed}} in Toronto.
By the time she retires, she {{will have been teaching|'ll have been teaching|will have taught|'ll have taught}} for forty years.
I {{will be seeing|'ll be seeing|will see|'ll see}} Julia tomorrow, so I can give her your message.
You {{won't have forgotten|will not have forgotten}} the tickets, will you?
Their flight was three hours late, so they {{will have missed|'ll have missed}} their connection by now.
By next summer, how long {{will you have been living|will you have lived}} in this flat?

exercises.title: Выберите правильную форму
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, который лучше всего подходит по смыслу.

items.q: Don't call at nine; I ___ a lecture.
items.why: В этот момент действие будет идти — **future continuous**.

items.q: By Friday, I ___ all the exams.
In June she ___ in the company for twenty years.
___ the car tonight? If not, can I borrow it?
items.why: Вежливый вопрос о планах — **will you be using**.

items.q: We can't come to your party on Saturday - all afternoon we ___ boxes into our new flat.
items.why: Процесс, который будет идти весь этот период (all afternoon), — **will be carrying**.

items.q: Hurry up! By the time we get there, the film ___.
items.why: Фильм начнётся раньше нашего прихода — **future perfect**.

items.q: Look at the time - she ___ home by now.
items.why: Предположение о завершённом событии — **will have arrived**.

items.q: Ring me anytime tomorrow afternoon. I ___ at home.
items.why: Процесс в течение будущего периода — **will be working**.

options: I will be knowing the results by Friday.
I will know the results by Friday.
items.why: Know — глагол состояния, continuous не нужен.

options: By the time you arrive, I will have cooked dinner.

She will have given a talk at nine tomorrow.

Next month he will be living here for a decade.
By midnight, they'll be finishing the report.
By midnight, they'll have finished the report.
Will you have been using the printer? I need it.
Will you be using the printer? I need it.
items.why: Вежливый вопрос о планах — future continuous.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте на вопросы полными предложениями на английском, используя future continuous, future perfect и future perfect continuous.

items.prompt: What will you be doing this time tomorrow?
items.sample: This time tomorrow I'll be sitting in a meeting and probably checking my emails.

items.prompt: What will you have achieved by the end of this year?
items.sample: By the end of this year I'll have passed my English exam and saved some money for a trip.

items.prompt: How long will you have been learning English by next year?
items.sample: By next year I'll have been learning English for six years.

items.prompt: Write a polite question to a colleague about their plans (Will you be ...?).
items.sample: Will you be going to the conference next week?

items.prompt: Make a guess about what a friend in another time zone is doing right now.
items.sample: It's midnight in Tokyo, so my friend will be sleeping.
